name: Sofia Vargas
bio:
Sofia Vargas's journey in motorsport began unexpectedly. While studying engineering at the National University of Colombia, she volunteered at a local racing team as a data analyst. Her knack for understanding complex systems and identifying performance bottlenecks quickly led to a full-time position. Over the years, she worked her way up, gaining experience in various technical and managerial roles within South American racing series before joining Reiza Studios Factory. 

As a sporting director, Sofia is known for her pragmatic approach. She prioritizes data-driven decision-making and focuses on optimizing team performance through meticulous planning and resource allocation. Her experience has taught her the importance of clear communication and fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels valued and empowered. Sofia's reputation for level-headedness and strategic thinking makes her a valuable asset in high-pressure situations.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled in a low bun
physical.description: A woman of medium build with a composed demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Insists on a daily team debriefing, no matter how brief.
Prefers to communicate via email, even when in the same room.
